scope: bounded incremental corpus join; no fitted model outputs

quarantined.interpretationlimits: preserves source gate; does not diagnose cause

acquisition_state.interpretationlimits: state is not proof that media hash is verified

media_duration_ms.nullmeaning: artifact, source identity, or duration unavailable/invalid
media_duration_ms.interpretationlimits: does not establish speech or scene duration

media_duration_seconds.interpretationlimits: derived from media receipt; no timing quality claim

media_has_audio.nullmeaning: media evidence unavailable or flag unverified

media_source_identity_state.meaning: media JSON and binary hash agreement
media_source_identity_state.source_formula: corpus artifact hash, observed binary hash, and .media.json sha256 comparison
media_source_identity_state.interpretationlimits: hash integrity is identity evidence, not content quality

media_corpus_expected_sha256.meaning: binary hash recorded by corpus receipt
media_corpus_expected_sha256.source_formula: corpus acquisition artifact map MP4 entry
media_corpus_expected_sha256.interpretationlimits: receipt expectation only until observed hash agrees

media_observed_sha256.source_formula: hash of artifact file after fail-closed path checks

media_artifact_verified.meaning: acquisition artifact and binary are hash verified
media_artifact_verified.source_formula: acquisition state OBSERVED plus JSON and MP4 hash checks pass
media_artifact_verified.interpretationlimits: verified coverage denominator; does not imply usable audio

transcript_state.interpretationlimits: EMPTY_OUTPUT_UNVERIFIED is not silence; SUSPICIOUS_TIMINGS is not corrected

asr_language.interpretationlimits: reported ASR output; not independently validated

asr_language_probability.interpretationlimits: source confidence only; no pooled language claim

transcript_word_count_lexical.meaning: lexical/token count retained by ASR receipt
transcript_word_count_lexical.source_formula: verified transcript words, lexical_word_count, or raw_word_count
transcript_word_count_lexical.interpretationlimits: implementation tokenization; not cross-language linguistic ground truth

transcript_words_per_second.nullmeaning: verified words or positive duration unavailable
transcript_words_per_second.interpretationlimits: LANGUAGE_CONDITIONED_TOKEN_RATE only; never pooled across languages without validation

transcript_aligned_words_per_second.nullmeaning: verified aligned count or positive duration unavailable
transcript_aligned_words_per_second.interpretationlimits: language-conditioned implementation metric; not speech fluency or quality

transcript_rate_comparability.source_formula: known language plus rate => LANGUAGE_CONDITIONED_TOKEN_RATE; otherwise explicit unknown/unavailable

transcript_source_identity_state.source_formula: transcript.source_media_hash compared with verified media binary hash

transcript_artifact_verified.meaning: observed transcript artifact and source identity verified
transcript_artifact_verified.source_formula: transcript state OBSERVED plus JSON hash and source hash checks pass
transcript_artifact_verified.interpretationlimits: verified artifact denominator; not ASR quality approval

frames_state.interpretationlimits: does not imply full temporal coverage

frame_sample_count.interpretationlimits: sample count, not shot or scene count

cut_observation_state.interpretationlimits: technical candidate observation; cuts are not scenes

cut_candidate_count.nullmeaning: cuts absent, unverified, or frame artifact unavailable
cut_candidate_count.source_formula: length of cut list only when cut_observation_state OBSERVED
cut_candidate_count.interpretationlimits: zero means observed empty list; null means no verified cut observation

frames_source_identity_state.source_formula: frame.source_media_hash compared with verified media binary hash

frames_artifact_verified.meaning: observed frame artifact and source identity verified
frames_artifact_verified.source_formula: frames state OBSERVED plus JSON hash and source hash checks pass
frames_artifact_verified.interpretationlimits: verified artifact denominator; not scene review

account_cluster_id.meaning: account key for future grouped summaries
account_cluster_id.interpretationlimits: grouping key only; no causal account effect

views.nullmeaning: missing, nonfinite, or negative source value
views.source_formula: metadata views after finite nonnegative validation
views.interpretationlimits: source observation; no reach claim without dated provenance

total_actions_per_1k_views.meaning: sum of four complete action rates
total_actions_per_1k_views.source_formula: sum of likes, comments, reshares, saves when all are valid
total_actions_per_1k_views.interpretationlimits: descriptive composite; not a performance or causal outcome

comparability_gate.source_formula: explicit account, numeric_valid true, positive views, four rates, snapshot date

metric_eligibility_gate.source_formula: comparability gate plus canonical quarantine gate
metric_eligibility_gate.interpretationlimits: does not authorize inference or model fitting

scene_review_state.interpretationlimits: review pending is not accepted scene evidence

reviewed_scene_state.source_formula: DISABLED_MVP until exact media/annotation/review receipt proof is implemented
reviewed_scene_state.interpretationlimits: structural labels remain unavailable in this lane

structural_label_state.meaning: availability of independently reviewed structural labels
structural_label_state.interpretationlimits: no heuristic labels or transcript sections promoted

missingness_reasons.nullmeaning: empty list means no recorded gap
missingness_reasons.source_formula: stage states, artifact/hash/source checks, metric validation, review gates
missingness_reasons.interpretationlimits: audit trail; not a severity score

model_gate.interpretationlimits: no regression, p-values, causal, or predictive conclusions
